Florida has islands, beaches, swamps, and sugar. What it does not have is mountains.
Stop 10, Mount Calaga. Florida's highest natural point is Britain Hill, just 105 meters.
That's the lowest top point of any US state. Plenty of Miami skyscrapers are taller than
Florida's tallest hill. But GTA 6's Florida has a whole mountain national park. Fans traced its
Canyons to Providence Canyon in neighboring Georgia.
